mapper.select: select card_message.id, user.id as user_id, user.name as username, card_message.color, card_message.content, label.name as label, card_message.like_count as like_count, card_message.comment_count as comment_count, card_message.create_time as date from card_message left join label on card_message.label_id = label.id left join user on card_message.user_id = user.id where card_message.id = #{cardId};
